host.scope: Suite Apple M3 runner; exact OS captured, no separate cohort hardware probe.

timing_boundary: Three shuffled sequential fresh-process observations per source; startup/input/work/complete output/shutdown included. Preparation/hashing excluded.

required_work.whole_input_read: STDIN.gets_to_end in each fresh native process
required_work.library_boundary: Ordinary installed String.scan/Regex/PCRE2/String.gsub APIs; no authored native regex executor or custom FFI. Every authored helper and scheduling statement is included in reviewed application LOC.
required_work.parallel_schedule: Eight source-owned count fibers send indexed totals through standard Channel; main receives all eight before ninth scan/output and all five replacements. Shared cleaned String is unchanged while counting; each worker constructs its own default Regex from identical source. Output is serialized in PATTERNS order.
required_work.scan_api_findings: Pinned String.scan starts byte_offset0 with default MatchOptions::None, calls match_at_byte_index, advances by actual byte_begin/byte_end (and handles zero-length progress), then adds NO_UTF_CHECK only after a successful first checked search. Array scan delegates to block scan and retains MatchData objects; it does not change scan work.
required_work.regex_engine_findings: Pinned PCRE2 wrapper adds UTF/UCP/DUPNAMES by default, attempts ordinary JIT compilation at construction with documented fallback for JIT_BADOPTION, and maps invalid UTF errors to ArgumentError. No source-supplied NO_UTF_CHECK, NO_JIT or alternate engine options.
required_work.jit_limit: Default JIT compilation path is established from pinned library code/linkage; this review did not observe per-pattern JIT success or execute an engine probe.
required_work.validation_limit: The four native invalid-UTF8 rejections occur in unchanged initial gsub. They establish application rejection; first-scan validation is a separate static conclusion from pinned stdlib, not an isolated native scan witness.
required_work.mechanism_limit: Byte-position progress and validation-once behavior are visible source/API changes. No native profile apportions elapsed savings between offset conversion, repeated UTF checking, allocation or scheduling.

source_size_scope: Approved exact retained Crystal policy only; uniform logical and native formatted metrics unavailable.
protocol_limits: Power/low-power settings and process listing are captured once before the cohort, not before and after every observation. Do not invent per-observation brackets.
Only12 declared source observations are admitted; three utility command receipts use the same quantitative helper but are not benchmark samples.
Fixed shuffled3round cohort with3samples/source supports these measured medians; it is not a global-optimality or general statistical precision claim.
Saved producer standard deviations should be retained exactly and recomputation checked with tight relative tolerance across Python versions. Samples and medians must remain exact.
